name: San Mateo County Human Services Agency
description: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for San Mateo County residents, including Daly City, Redwood City and the rest of the Peninsula.
fullDescription: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for San Mateo County residents, including Daly City, Redwood City and the rest of the Peninsula.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medi-Cal applications, renewals and eligibility questions
- CalFresh (food stamps) applications and recertification
- CalWORKs cash aid for families with children
- Aging and Adult Services, including IHSS
howToGetIt:
Apply online at BenefitsCal.com any time, or call the toll-free line to find the nearest office and start an application by phone.

Adults over 65 and people with disabilities apply through Medi-Cal's Aged, Blind and Disabled programme, which the county handles and which uses different rules from the working-age one — ask for it by name.
